deadlines.dateText: *Rolling application procedure:** You can apply for a place all year round until all places have been allocated. The latest date to apply for the coming **winter semester** is 15 August of the same year. **Early Bird:** If you apply by 15 June for the winter semester, you do not pay an application fee (the one-off application fee is 50 EUR) and secure your place early.
